worldcombat.skill.ember.summary: Flicks out a small, quick spark on a free aim; gravity and real wall collisions decide its shallow arc, and only a genuine ignition leaves a lingering flame on the target. Fast to fire and quick to recover - the steadiest little fire when nothing else is ready.
worldcombat.skill.ember.use.0: Finish with a quick tossed spark
worldcombat.skill.ember.use.2: Toss the spark over a low wall or onto open ground ahead
worldcombat.skill.ember.description.0: The spark is tossed freely at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s block radius and hits one foe for about %1$s special damage; at the end of its range or on a wall it settles at the projectile's real endpoint.
worldcombat.skill.ember.description.1: Range %1$s blocks; a hit that deals damage has a %2$s chance to burn the target. Burn lasts 40 seconds, during which the target loses 1/16 of its max HP every 5 seconds (at least 1) and its physical attacks deal half damage; Fire-type targets cannot be burned. A hit that does not ignite leaves no lingering flame.
worldcombat.skill.ember.charged.on: Charged: power x1.4 and ignition +5%, but +4 ticks wind-up, +8 cooldown and -1 block range.
worldcombat.skill.ember.charged.off: Rapid: faster to fire, farther and quicker to recover, at the cost of power and ignition.
worldcombat.skill.ember.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, costing %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.ember.growth.0: From level %1$s the spark rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.ember.growth.1: From level %1$s the spark rises to %2$s power and %3$s ignition chance.
worldcombat.skill.ember.preference.charg: On: power x1.4 and ignition +5%, but +4 ticks wind-up, +8 cooldown and -1 block range. Off (rapid): faster to fire, farther and quicker to recover, at the cost of power and ignition.
worldcombat.skill.ember.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.ember.preference.ai.fi: On: low-health targets rank first, finished with this cheap spark; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
